pla-01.prompt: Edit this existing educational family-tree image. Preserve exactly its visual style, all six full-body people, their clothes and identities, all family connections and the blue and red highlights and red arrow. The reference child is bottom left in blue; the target cousin is bottom right in red. The grandparents together occupy the top frame, their two adult children are separate middle frames, each adult connects down only to their own child. Correct the composition by shrinking the ENTIRE diagram to 78 percent of the canvas width and height, centered, with at least 100 pixels of completely empty white space above, below, left and right. Restore all cropped top frame edges and the complete grandparents' hair and heads. All frames, feet, connectors and arrow must be completely inside the canvas. Pure white background. No writing, no numbers, no brands, no symbols resembling text.
